scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run sync:web && npm run build:backend
scripts.types:relay: cd apps/relay && npx wrangler types --config wrangler.jsonc --env-file .dev.vars.example --no-strict-vars
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:web && cd apps/web && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name termlinks --branch main
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:relay && npm run test:go
